newsitem.title: USA: Terra Nova - lower prices to affect earnings.
newsitem.headline: Terra Nova - lower prices to affect earnings.

text.p: Terra Nova (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd said Monday that its earnings in 1996 and 1997 will reflect deteriorating price levels as well as normal and catastrophic losses.

In a presentation to analysts and investors, company Chairman William Bailey also said that net premiums written for 1996 would exceed the previous 15 percent to 20 percent growth projection. The company now anticipates growth in premiums written by about 25 percent, it said.

The company also estimated that premiums written in 1997 would increase by between 30 percent and 35 percent. The increase was attributed primarily to a large increase in the company's participation in a syndicate managed by Octavian Syndicate Management Ltd, the company's Lloyd's of London managing agency.
